en.text:
Reloads its entire magazine at once.

Passive 5% increased damage falloff distance compared to similar shotguns.

While Hip-Firing, this gun fires a spread of 12 pellets in the pattern of a Precision Frame shotgun, each pellet dealing <pve 104 /> <pvp [?] /> damage.

While Aiming Down Sights, this gun fires a single slug round, dealing <pve 1891 /> <pvp [?] /> precision damage.
